reviewer: bounded_idea_supply, source-free messages before target counting
proof: For the actual global marker, one of the two parsings is the restriction of the actual code stream. Thus P0 intersect P1 is a subset of the actual pair dictionary for each contiguous snippet, and union of these intersections remains a subset. Minimum over marker choices is a valid necessary bound, not an exact optimum.
edge_cases: Control h may occur second in a pair; offset1 remains allowed even if the first snippet unit is h.
Do not count an incoming partial pair or final incomplete non-h pair. At a code boundary a final h is a complete singleton.
Every snippet must retain every internal working unit in original order. No deletion of unknown symbols or concatenation of disjoint source spans.
Union of intersections is essential. NONE snippets aba,bab each have empty intersection; intersection of unions would wrongly force ab andba.
fixtures: xbcx with marker x, including incoming partial ax, forces bc
abxc with marker x has P0={ab},P1={bx}
limitations: No native pair counts, source data, glyph values or image interpretation by reviewer. Numeric verification remains separate same-author code.
